import TransposeFollowup.NativeMicrocodeRun
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.EquivFin

/-! Every fixed finite port/label system admits the original Fin encodings,
with any chosen start label mapped to native state zero. Choosing this
finite enumeration is part of fixing the machine, not a runtime operation. -/

namespace TransposeFollowup.NativeMicrocode

open FixedTapeCompiler
set_option autoImplicit false
variable {T L : Type*} [Fintype T] [Fintype L]

noncomputable def initialEncoding (start : L) :
    Encoding T L (Fintype.card T) (Fintype.card L - 1) := by
  classical
  letI : Nonempty L := ⟨start⟩
  have h : Fintype.card L = Fintype.card L - 1 + 1 := by
    have := Fintype.card_pos (α := L)
    omega
  let e : L ≃ Fin (Fintype.card L - 1 + 1) := Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq h
  exact ⟨Fintype.equivFin T, e.trans (Equiv.swap (e start) 0)⟩

@[simp] theorem initialEncoding_start (start : L) :
    (initialEncoding (T := T) start).label start = 0 := by
  classical
  simp [initialEncoding]

/-- In particular, the compiler never needs a size-indexed state space. -/
theorem finite_program_native_trajectory (p : Microcode.Program T L) (start : L)
    (w : List Bool) (n : ℕ) (t : T) :
    Transpose.Tape.workTraj (machine (initialEncoding start) p) w n
      ((initialEncoding start).port t) = (run p n (blankConfig start)).pos t :=
  native_trajectory (initialEncoding start) p w start (initialEncoding_start start) n t

end TransposeFollowup.NativeMicrocode

abbrev Trace (ops : Fin q → PageOpcode) := OperationalTrace.Trace (step ops) (Active ops)

namespace TransposeFollowup.FusedPageClock
open FixedTapeCompiler CopyMachine
open ReusablePageClock (Port Label program cfg nativeEncoding)
set_option autoImplicit false
variable {q : ℕ}

theorem rewind_region_step (ops : Fin q → PageOpcode) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config (Port q) Label)
    (h : ∃ pc,c.core.pc=.inr pc) : ∃ pc,(step ops c).core.pc=.inr pc := by
  simp only [step]
  rcases NativeReadFusion.step_one_or_two (program ops) selected c with he|he
  · rw [he];exact ReusablePageClock.rewind_region_step ops c h
  · rw [he]
    exact ReusablePageClock.rewind_region_step ops _ (ReusablePageClock.rewind_region_step ops c h)

    (h : ∃ pc,c.core.pc=.inr pc) (p : Fin q) : (step ops c).pos (some p)=c.pos (some p) := by
  simp only [step]
  rcases NativeReadFusion.step_one_or_two (program ops) selected c with he|he
  · rw [he];exact ReusablePageClock.rewind_page_step ops c h p
  · rw [he]
    exact (ReusablePageClock.rewind_page_step ops _ (ReusablePageClock.rewind_region_step ops c h) p).trans
      (ReusablePageClock.rewind_page_step ops c h p)

theorem rewind_page_run (ops : Fin q → PageOpcode) (s : ℕ) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config (Port q) Label)
    (h : ∃ pc,c.core.pc=.inr pc) (p : Fin q) : (run ops s c).pos (some p)=c.pos (some p) := by
  induction s generalizing c with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ s ih => exact (ih (step ops c) (rewind_region_step ops c h)).trans (rewind_page_step ops c h p)

theorem page_trajectory (ops : Fin q → PageOpcode) (xs : List Bool) (s : ℕ) (pos : Port q → ℤ) (p : Fin q) :
    (run ops s (cfg (.inl .read) (Counter.marked xs) pos)).pos (some p)=
      pos (some p)+(ops p).direction*((xs.take s).count true) := by
  by_cases hs : s ≤ xs.length
  · rw [prefix_run ops xs s hs pos];rfl
  · have hr:=OperationalTrace.trace_run (scan_trace ops xs pos)
    have ht:s=(xs.length+1)+(s-(xs.length+1)):=by omega
    have hi:xs.length ≤ s:=by omega
    simp only [run,NativeReadFusion.run]
    conv_lhs => rw [ht,OperationalTrace.run_add,hr]
    rw [rewind_page_run ops _ _ ⟨.back,rfl⟩,List.take_of_length_le hi]
    rfl

    (input : List Bool) (ip : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) :
    (OperationalTrace.run (Transpose.Tape.Impl.next (nativeMachine ops) input) s
      (NativeReadFusion.denote (nativeEncoding q) (program ops) selected ip outRev
        (cfg (.inl .read) (Counter.marked xs) pos))).workPos
        ((nativeEncoding q).port (some p))=pos (some p)+(ops p).direction*((xs.take s).count true) := by
  unfold nativeMachine
  rw [NativeReadFusion.run_denote]

    (input : List Bool) (ip : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) :
    Transpose.stepN (nativeMachine ops) input (14*R+3)
      (NativeReadFusion.denote (nativeEncoding q) (program ops) selected ip outRev
        (cfg (.inl .read) (Counter.marked (SevenPhaseClock.word R)) pos))=
      some (NativeReadFusion.denote (nativeEncoding q) (program ops) selected ip outRev
        (cfg (.inr .done) (Counter.marked (SevenPhaseClock.word R)) (PageClock.advance ops pos 0 (4*R)))) ∧

        (cfg (.inr .done) (Counter.marked (SevenPhaseClock.word R)) (PageClock.advance ops pos 0 (4*R))))=none := by
  have h:=native_complete ops (SevenPhaseClock.word R) pos input ip outRev
  simpa only [SevenPhaseClock.word_length,SevenPhaseClock.word_count,show 2*(7*R)+3=14*R+3 by ring] using h

theorem native_record_trajectory (ops : Fin q → PageOpcode) (R s : ℕ) (pos : Port q → ℤ) (p : Fin q)
    (input : List Bool) (ip : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) :
    (OperationalTrace.run (Transpose.Tape.Impl.next (nativeMachine ops) input) s
      (NativeReadFusion.denote (nativeEncoding q) (program ops) selected ip outRev
        (cfg (.inl .read) (Counter.marked (SevenPhaseClock.word R)) pos))).workPos
        ((nativeEncoding q).port (some p))=recordRun R (ops p) (pos (some p)) s := by
  rw [native_page_trajectory,SevenPhaseClock.count_ramp,recordRun_eq]

    2*n*(14*(K*Transpose.Tape.TSDiagram.blockSize G n)+3) ≤ (28*K+6)*Transpose.inputLength n := by
  have hr:=Transpose.Tape.Impl.blockSize_le (n:=n) hG
  have hm:=Nat.mul_le_mul_left (n*K) hr
  have hnP:=DimensionCandidate.dimension_le_length n hn
  unfold Transpose.inputLength at hnP ⊢
  nlinarith

end TransposeFollowup.FusedPageClock

row boundary and every intermediate page position. The clock is the sole
prepared auxiliary input of this composition theorem. -/

set_option autoImplicit false
variable {r : ℕ}

theorem prepared_geometry (F : Fin (r+1) → RationalMobius) (clock : List Bool)
    (cpos : ReusablePageClock.Port (rationalPageCount F) → ℤ) (w : List Bool) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hw : w.length=Transpose.inputLength n) (gpos : OpcodeGenerator.Port → ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) :
    ∃ xs,NativeTrim.Normalized xs ∧ Counter.value xs=n ∧ xs.length=n.size ∧
    ∃ a ≤ OpcodeGenerator.coefficient F*w.length+8*n*rationalPageCount F+5,
      (∀ front tail,GeneratedRowClock.rows F n=front++tail →
        Transpose.stepN (nativeMachine F) w (a+front.length*RowLoop.period (rationalPageCount F) clock)
          (NativeIOFusion.denote (nativeEncoding F) (program F) (selected F)
            (join (.inl (OpcodeGenerator.start F)) (first F gpos outRev) (Counter.marked clock) cpos))=
          some (NativeIOFusion.denote (nativeEncoding F) (program F) (selected F)
            (rowJoin .guard (last F w xs gpos outRev) ⟨(symbols (RowLoop.bits front)).reverse,symbols (RowLoop.bits tail)⟩
              (Counter.marked clock) (NativeZipper.shiftPositions (fun _ => gpos VertexScheduler.outputPort)
                (2*(rationalPageCount F:ℤ)*front.length)) (RowLoop.finishPos front clock cpos)))) ∧
      (∀ front tail ops,GeneratedRowClock.rows F n=front++ops::tail →
        ∀ s,s ≤ RowLoop.period (rationalPageCount F) clock → ∀ p : Fin (rationalPageCount F),
          (OperationalTrace.run (Transpose.Tape.Impl.next (nativeMachine F) w)
            (a+(front.length*RowLoop.period (rationalPageCount F) clock+s))
            (NativeIOFusion.denote (nativeEncoding F) (program F) (selected F)

may contain arbitrary caller continuations. All unused tapes and absolute
positions are retained, and the native transition count is unchanged. -/

open CopyMachine (Sym)

set_option autoImplicit false
variable {T U L J A : Type*}

@[simp] theorem extend_at (ports : T ↪ U) (t : T) (g : T → A) (f : U → A) :
    Function.extend ports g f (ports t) = g t := ports.injective.extend_apply g f t

theorem extend_outside (ports : T ↪ U) (u : U) (h : ¬∃ t, ports t = u)
    (g : T → A) (f : U → A) : Function.extend ports g f u = f u :=
  Function.extend_apply' g f u h

noncomputable def instruction (ports : T ↪ U) (labels : L → J) :
    Instruction T L → Instruction U J
  | .read t next => .read (ports t) (labels ∘ next)
  | .act acts next => .act (Function.extend ports acts (fun _ => idle)) (labels next)
  | .jump next => .jump (labels next)
  | .halt => .halt
  | .reject => .reject

  tapes : U → Turing.Tape (Sym Bool)

  core := ⟨labels c.core.pc, Function.extend ports c.core.tapes frame.tapes⟩
  pos := Function.extend ports c.pos frame.pos

    (bank : T → Turing.Tape (Sym Bool)) (frame : U → Turing.Tape (Sym Bool)) :

      Function.extend ports (fun t => (acts t).actual (bank t)) frame := by
  classical

  by_cases hu : ∃ t, ports t = u
  · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hu

  · simp only [extend_outside ports u hu, idle, Microcode.Action.actual]

      Function.extend ports (fun t => (NativeMicrocode.direction (acts t).move).shift (pos t))

  classical
  funext u
  by_cases hu : ∃ t, ports t = u
  · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hu
    simp only [extend_at]
  · simp only [extend_outside ports u hu, idle, NativeMicrocode.direction, Transpose.Dir.shift]

/-! Add physical access to the original read-only input and write-only
output. Existing work-tape microcode remains reusable without changing its
instructions or paying an unbounded oracle. Every new instruction is one
original TM transition. -/
namespace TransposeFollowup.NativeIO
open FixedTapeCompiler
open NativeMicrocode (Encoding symbolCode symbolDecode)
set_option autoImplicit false
variable {T L : Type*} {k q : ℕ}

inductive Instruction (T L : Type*)
  | work (i : Microcode.Instruction T L)
  | readInput (next : Option Bool → L)
  | moveInput (dir : Transpose.Dir) (next : L)
  | output (bit : Bool) (next : L)

abbrev Program (T L : Type*) := L → Instruction T L

def workProgram (p : Program T L) : Microcode.Program T L :=
  fun pc => match p pc with | .work i => i | _ => .reject

def delta (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L)
    (s : Fin (q+1)) (input : Option Bool) (scanned : Fin k → Fin 5) :
    Option (Fin (q+1) × Transpose.Dir × (Fin k → Fin 5 × Transpose.Dir) × Option Bool) :=
  match p (e.label.symm s) with
  | .work _ => NativeMicrocode.delta e (workProgram p) s input scanned
  | .readInput next => some (e.label (next input),.stay,fun i => (scanned i,.stay),none)
  | .moveInput dir next => some (e.label next,dir,fun i => (scanned i,.stay),none)
  | .output bit next => some (e.label next,.stay,fun i => (scanned i,.stay),some bit)

abbrev machine (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) : Transpose.TM where
  k:=k; g:=4; q:=q; δ:=delta e p

structure Config (T L : Type*) where
  work : NativeMicrocode.Config T L
  inputPos : ℤ
  outRev : List Bool

def Config.denote (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (c : Config T L) : Transpose.Config (machine e p) where
  state:=e.label c.work.core.pc
  inPos:=c.inputPos
  work:=fun i z => symbolCode (AbsoluteTape.cells (c.work.core.tapes (e.port.symm i))
    (c.work.pos (e.port.symm i)) z)
  workPos:=fun i => c.work.pos (e.port.symm i)
  outRev:=c.outRev

def setLabel (c : Config T L) (next : L) : Config T L :=
  {c with work:={c.work with core:={c.work.core with pc:=next}}}

def step (p : Program T L) (w : List Bool) (c : Config T L) : Config T L :=
  match p c.work.core.pc with
  | .work _ => {c with work:=NativeMicrocode.step (workProgram p) c.work}
  | .readInput next => setLabel c (next (Transpose.readInput w c.inputPos))
  | .moveInput dir next => {setLabel c next with inputPos:=dir.shift c.inputPos}
  | .output bit next => {setLabel c next with outRev:=bit::c.outRev}

def Active (p : Program T L) (c : Config T L) : Prop :=
  match p c.work.core.pc with | .work i => i≠.halt ∧ i≠.reject | _ => True

/-- The same one-step jump rule includes unchanged input and output state. -/
theorem jump_trace (p : Program T L) (w : List Bool) (c : Config T L) (next : L)
    (h : p c.work.core.pc = .work (.jump next)) :
    OperationalTrace.Trace (step p w) (Active p) 1 c (setLabel c next) := by
  apply OperationalTrace.Trace.cons
  · simp [Active, h]
  · have hs : step p w c = setLabel c next := by
      simp [step, workProgram, NativeMicrocode.step, Microcode.actualStep, setLabel, h]
    rw [hs]
    exact .refl _

theorem step_none_iff (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (w : List Bool) (c : Config T L) :
    Transpose.step (machine e p) w (c.denote e p)=none ↔ ¬Active p c := by
  cases hp : p c.work.core.pc with
  | work i => cases i <;> simp [Transpose.step,Config.denote,machine,delta,NativeMicrocode.delta,workProgram,hp,Active]
  | _ => simp [Transpose.step,Config.denote,machine,delta,hp,Active]

theorem step_denote (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (w : List Bool) (c : Config T L) :
    Transpose.Tape.Impl.next (machine e p) w (c.denote e p)=(step p w c).denote e p := by
  cases hp : p c.work.core.pc with
  | work i =>
    let lift : Transpose.Config (NativeMicrocode.machine e (workProgram p)) →
        Transpose.Config (machine e p) :=
      fun d => ⟨d.state, d.inPos, d.work, d.workPos, d.outRev⟩
    have hh := congrArg lift
      (NativeMicrocode.step_denote e (workProgram p) w c.inputPos c.outRev c.work)
    convert hh using 1
    · simp only [Transpose.Tape.Impl.next, Transpose.step, Config.denote,
        NativeMicrocode.Config.denote, machine, NativeMicrocode.machine, delta,
        Equiv.symm_apply_apply, hp, lift]
      split <;> rfl
    · simp only [step, hp, Config.denote, lift, NativeMicrocode.Config.denote]
  | _ =>
    simp only [Transpose.Tape.Impl.next,Transpose.step,Config.denote,machine,delta,
      Equiv.symm_apply_apply,hp,AbsoluteTape.scanned,Option.getD_some,step,setLabel,Transpose.Dir.shift]
    congr 1
    funext i z
    split_ifs with hz
    · subst z; simp [AbsoluteTape.scanned]
    · simp [hz]

    (c : Config T L) (ha : Active p c) :
    Transpose.step (machine e p) w (c.denote e p)=some ((step p w c).denote e p) := by
  cases hs : Transpose.step (machine e p) w (c.denote e p) with
  | none => exact False.elim ((step_none_iff e p w c).mp hs ha)
  | some d =>
    have hd : d=(step p w c).denote e p := by
      simpa [Transpose.Tape.Impl.next,hs] using step_denote e p w c
    exact congrArg some hd

theorem trace_stepN (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (w : List Bool)
    {n : ℕ} {c d : Config T L} (h : OperationalTrace.Trace (step p w) (Active p) n c d) :
    Transpose.stepN (machine e p) w n (c.denote e p)=some (d.denote e p) := by
  induction h with
  | refl c => rfl
  | cons ha tr ih => rw [Transpose.stepN,step_some_of_active e p w _ ha]; exact ih

theorem work_step (p : Program T L) (w : List Bool) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L)
    (ha : NativeMicrocode.Active (workProgram p) c) (inputPos : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) :
    step p w ⟨c,inputPos,outRev⟩=⟨NativeMicrocode.step (workProgram p) c,inputPos,outRev⟩ ∧
      Active p ⟨c,inputPos,outRev⟩ := by
  cases hp : p c.core.pc with
  | work i => exact ⟨by simp [step,hp],by simpa only [Active,hp,NativeMicrocode.Active,workProgram] using ha⟩
  | _ => simp [NativeMicrocode.Active,workProgram,hp] at ha

theorem lift_work_trace (p : Program T L) (w : List Bool) (inputPos : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool)
    {n : ℕ} {c d : NativeMicrocode.Config T L}
    (h : OperationalTrace.Trace (NativeMicrocode.step (workProgram p)) (NativeMicrocode.Active (workProgram p)) n c d) :
    OperationalTrace.Trace (step p w) (Active p) n ⟨c,inputPos,outRev⟩ ⟨d,inputPos,outRev⟩ := by
  induction h with
  | refl c => exact .refl _
  | cons ha tr ih =>
    apply OperationalTrace.Trace.cons (work_step p w _ ha inputPos outRev).2
    rw [(work_step p w _ ha inputPos outRev).1]
    exact ih

theorem blank_denote (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (start : L) (hs : e.label start=0) :
    (⟨NativeMicrocode.blankConfig start,0,[]⟩ : Config T L).denote e p=Transpose.init (machine e p) := by
  unfold Config.denote NativeMicrocode.blankConfig Transpose.init
  rw [hs]
  congr 1
  funext i z
  rw [AbsoluteTape.blank_cells]
  rfl

end TransposeFollowup.NativeIO

variable {T L : Type*} {k q : ℕ}

    (s : Fin (q+1)) (input : Option Bool) (scanned : Fin k → Fin 5) :
    Option (Fin (q+1) × Transpose.Dir × (Fin k → Fin 5 × Transpose.Dir) × Option Bool) :=
  match p (e.label.symm s) with
  | .work _ => NativeReadFusion.delta e (workProgram p) selected s input scanned
  | _ => NativeIO.delta e p s input scanned

abbrev machine (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) : Transpose.TM where
  k:=k;g:=4;q:=q;δ:=delta e p selected

def denote (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (selected : L → Bool)
    (c : Config T L) : Transpose.Config (machine e p selected) where
  state:=e.label c.work.core.pc
  inPos:=c.inputPos
  work:=fun i z => symbolCode (AbsoluteTape.cells (c.work.core.tapes (e.port.symm i)) (c.work.pos (e.port.symm i)) z)
  workPos:=fun i => c.work.pos (e.port.symm i)
  outRev:=c.outRev

def step (p : Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (w : List Bool) (c : Config T L) : Config T L :=
  match p c.work.core.pc with
  | .work _ => {c with work:=NativeReadFusion.step (workProgram p) selected c.work}
  | _ => NativeIO.step p w c

  match p c.work.core.pc with
  | .work _ => NativeReadFusion.Active (workProgram p) selected c.work
  | _ => True

    Active p selected c ↔ NativeIO.Active p c := by
  cases hp : p c.work.core.pc with
  | work i => simp only [Active,NativeIO.Active,hp,NativeReadFusion.active_iff,NativeMicrocode.Active,workProgram]
  | _ => simp [Active,NativeIO.Active,hp]

  cases hp : p c.work.core.pc with

  match x.val with
  | 0 => .blank
  | 1 => .start
  | 2 => .stop
  | 3 => .data false
  | _ => .data true

  cases x with
  | blank => rfl

  | .right => .right

/-! Exact finite-program execution in the first paper's machine model.
The run theorem preserves all absolute head positions. Active traces give
the partial stepN semantics, so a frozen halted run cannot count as further
executed instructions. Both halt and reject stop the compiled machine. -/

namespace TransposeFollowup.NativeMicrocode

open FixedTapeCompiler
open Microcode (Instruction Program)

set_option autoImplicit false
variable {T L : Type*} {k q : ℕ}

def Active (p : Program T L) (c : Config T L) : Prop :=
  p c.core.pc ≠ .halt ∧ p c.core.pc ≠ .reject

/-- A jump changes only the control label and consumes exactly one active step. -/
theorem jump_trace (p : Program T L) (c : Config T L) (next : L)
    (h : p c.core.pc = .jump next) :
    OperationalTrace.Trace (step p) (Active p) 1 c
      {c with core := {c.core with pc := next}} := by
  apply OperationalTrace.Trace.cons
  · simp [Active, h]
  · have hs : step p c = {c with core := {c.core with pc := next}} := by
      simp [step, Microcode.actualStep, h]
    rw [hs]
    exact .refl _

theorem step_none_iff (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (w : List Bool)
    (inputPos : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) (c : Config T L) :
    Transpose.step (machine e p) w (c.denote e p inputPos outRev) = none ↔
      ¬ Active p c := by
  cases hp : p c.core.pc <;>
    simp [Transpose.step, Config.denote, machine, delta, hp, Active]

theorem step_some_of_active (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (w : List Bool)
    (inputPos : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) (c : Config T L) (ha : Active p c) :
    Transpose.step (machine e p) w (c.denote e p inputPos outRev) =
      some ((step p c).denote e p inputPos outRev) := by
  cases hs : Transpose.step (machine e p) w (c.denote e p inputPos outRev) with
  | none => exact False.elim ((step_none_iff e p w inputPos outRev c).mp hs ha)
  | some d =>
    have hd : d = (step p c).denote e p inputPos outRev := by
      simpa [Transpose.Tape.Impl.next, hs] using step_denote e p w inputPos outRev c
    exact congrArg some hd

abbrev run (p : Program T L) := OperationalTrace.run (step p)

theorem run_core (p : Program T L) (n : ℕ) (c : Config T L) :
    (run p n c).core = Microcode.actualRun p n c.core := by
  induction n generalizing c with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simpa only [run, OperationalTrace.run, step] using ih (step p c)

theorem run_denote (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (w : List Bool)
    (inputPos : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) (n : ℕ) (c : Config T L) :
    OperationalTrace.run (Transpose.Tape.Impl.next (machine e p) w) n
      (c.denote e p inputPos outRev) = (run p n c).denote e p inputPos outRev := by
  induction n generalizing c with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simpa only [OperationalTrace.run, step_denote] using ih (step p c)

/-- A previously checked relative-tape computation transfers to native
states and every cell, measured relative to the actual final head. Input
position and output are preserved. Head resets still require a position
proof; they do not follow from an equality of relative tapes. -/
theorem actual_result_transfers (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L)
    (w : List Bool) (inputPos : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) (n : ℕ)
    (c : Config T L) (d : Microcode.ActualConfig T L)
    (h : Microcode.actualRun p n c.core = d) :
    let v := OperationalTrace.run (Transpose.Tape.Impl.next (machine e p) w) n
      (c.denote e p inputPos outRev)
    v.state = e.label d.pc ∧ v.inPos = inputPos ∧ v.outRev = outRev ∧
      ∀ t z, v.work (e.port t) (v.workPos (e.port t) + z) =
        symbolCode ((d.tapes t).nth z) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [run_denote]
  have hc : (run p n c).core = d := (run_core p n c).trans h
  refine ⟨congrArg (fun x : Microcode.ActualConfig T L => e.label x.pc) hc,
    rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  intro t z
  simp [Config.denote, AbsoluteTape.cells, hc]

theorem trace_stepN (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (w : List Bool)
    (inputPos : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) {n : ℕ} {c d : Config T L}
    (h : OperationalTrace.Trace (step p) (Active p) n c d) :
    Transpose.stepN (machine e p) w n (c.denote e p inputPos outRev) =
      some (d.denote e p inputPos outRev) := by
  induction h with
  | refl c => rfl
  | cons ha tr ih =>
    rw [Transpose.stepN, step_some_of_active e p w inputPos outRev _ ha]
    exact ih

def blankConfig (start : L) : Config T L where
  core := ⟨start, fun _ => AbsoluteTape.blank⟩
  pos := fun _ => 0

theorem blank_denote (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (start : L)
    (hs : e.label start = 0) :
    (blankConfig start).denote e p 0 [] = Transpose.init (machine e p) := by
  unfold Config.denote blankConfig Transpose.init
  rw [hs]
  congr 1
  funext i z
  rw [AbsoluteTape.blank_cells]
  rfl

theorem operationalRun_eq_iterate {C : Type*} (f : C → C) (n : ℕ) (c : C) :
    OperationalTrace.run f n c = f^[n] c := by
  induction n generalizing c with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [OperationalTrace.run, ih, Function.iterate_succ_apply]

theorem native_run (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (w : List Bool)
    (start : L) (hs : e.label start = 0) (n : ℕ) :
    Transpose.Tape.run (machine e p) w n =
      (run p n (blankConfig start)).denote e p 0 [] := by
  rw [Transpose.Tape.Impl.run_eq_iterate, ← operationalRun_eq_iterate,
    ← blank_denote e p start hs, run_denote]

theorem native_trajectory (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (w : List Bool)
    (start : L) (hs : e.label start = 0) (n : ℕ) (t : T) :
    Transpose.Tape.workTraj (machine e p) w n (e.port t) =
      (run p n (blankConfig start)).pos t := by
  change (Transpose.Tape.run (machine e p) w n).workPos (e.port t) = _
  rw [native_run e p w start hs]
  simp [Config.denote]

theorem inactive_fixed (p : Program T L) (c : Config T L) (ha : ¬ Active p c) :
    step p c = c := by
  cases hp : p c.core.pc <;> simp_all [Active, step, Microcode.actualStep]

/-- Stopping at or before n microsteps yields the original bounded-halting
predicate. This program class itself leaves input and output untouched. -/
theorem computesWithin_of_stopped (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L)
    (w : List Bool) (start : L) (hs : e.label start = 0) (n : ℕ)
    (hh : ¬ Active p (run p n (blankConfig start))) :
    Transpose.ComputesWithin (machine e p) w [] n := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htr⟩ := OperationalTrace.prune (step p) (Active p)
    (inactive_fixed p) n (blankConfig start)
  refine ⟨t, ht, (run p n (blankConfig start)).denote e p 0 [], ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
  · rw [← blank_denote e p start hs]
    exact trace_stepN e p w 0 [] htr
  · exact (step_none_iff e p w 0 [] _).mpr hh

end TransposeFollowup.NativeMicrocode

/-! Fuse a selected local work-tape read with its chosen action or jump.
The selected label set is fixed. The decision uses only the currently
scanned symbol. Every effective instruction is one original TM transition;
all unselected labels retain their previous transition semantics. -/
namespace TransposeFollowup.NativeReadFusion
open FixedTapeCompiler
open NativeMicrocode (Encoding symbolCode symbolDecode)
set_option autoImplicit false
variable {T L : Type*} {k q : ℕ}

def instruction (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (heads : T → CopyMachine.Sym Bool)
    (pc : L) : Microcode.Instruction T L :=
  if selected pc then match p pc with
    | .read t next => match p (next (heads t)) with
      | .act acts dest => .act acts dest
      | .jump dest => .jump dest
      | _ => .jump (next (heads t))
    | i => i
  else p pc

def effective (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (heads : T → CopyMachine.Sym Bool) :
    Microcode.Program T L := instruction p selected heads

def step (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L) : NativeMicrocode.Config T L :=
  NativeMicrocode.step (effective p selected (fun t => (c.core.tapes t).head)) c

def Active (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L) : Prop :=
  NativeMicrocode.Active (effective p selected (fun t => (c.core.tapes t).head)) c

abbrev run (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) := OperationalTrace.run (step p selected)

def delta (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool)
    (s : Fin (q+1)) (input : Option Bool) (scanned : Fin k → Fin 5) :
    Option (Fin (q+1) × Transpose.Dir × (Fin k → Fin 5 × Transpose.Dir) × Option Bool) :=
  NativeMicrocode.delta e (effective p selected (fun t => symbolDecode (scanned (e.port t)))) s input scanned

abbrev machine (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) : Transpose.TM where
  k:=k;g:=4;q:=q;δ:=delta e p selected

def denote (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool)
    (ip : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L) : Transpose.Config (machine e p selected) where
  state:=e.label c.core.pc
  inPos:=ip
  work:=fun i z => symbolCode (AbsoluteTape.cells (c.core.tapes (e.port.symm i)) (c.pos (e.port.symm i)) z)
  workPos:=fun i => c.pos (e.port.symm i)
  outRev:=outRev

theorem instruction_unselected (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (heads : T → CopyMachine.Sym Bool)
    (pc : L) (h:selected pc=false) : instruction p selected heads pc=p pc := by simp [instruction,h]

theorem step_unselected (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L)
    (h:selected c.core.pc=false) : step p selected c=NativeMicrocode.step p c := by
  simp [step,NativeMicrocode.step,Microcode.actualStep,effective,instruction,h]

theorem active_iff (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L) :
    Active p selected c ↔ NativeMicrocode.Active p c := by
  unfold Active NativeMicrocode.Active effective instruction
  by_cases hs : selected c.core.pc = true
  · simp only [hs, ite_true]
    cases hp : p c.core.pc with
    | read t next => cases h : p (next ((c.core.tapes t).head)) <;> simp [h]
    | _ => simp
  · simp [hs]


theorem step_read_act (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L)
    (t : T) (next : CopyMachine.Sym Bool → L) (acts : T → Microcode.Action) (dest : L)
    (hs:selected c.core.pc=true) (hp:p c.core.pc=.read t next) (hn:p (next ((c.core.tapes t).head))=.act acts dest) :
    step p selected c=NativeMicrocode.step p (NativeMicrocode.step p c) := by
  simp [step,NativeMicrocode.step,Microcode.actualStep,effective,instruction,hs,hp,hn]

theorem step_read_jump (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L)
    (t : T) (next : CopyMachine.Sym Bool → L) (dest : L)
    (hs:selected c.core.pc=true) (hp:p c.core.pc=.read t next) (hn:p (next ((c.core.tapes t).head))=.jump dest) :
    step p selected c=NativeMicrocode.step p (NativeMicrocode.step p c) := by
  simp [step,NativeMicrocode.step,Microcode.actualStep,effective,instruction,hs,hp,hn]

theorem step_denote (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool)
    (w : List Bool) (ip : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L) :
    Transpose.Tape.Impl.next (machine e p selected) w (denote e p selected ip outRev c)=
      denote e p selected ip outRev (step p selected c) := by
  let ep := effective p selected (fun t => (c.core.tapes t).head)
  let lift : Transpose.Config (NativeMicrocode.machine e ep) →
      Transpose.Config (machine e p selected) :=
    fun d => ⟨d.state, d.inPos, d.work, d.workPos, d.outRev⟩
  have hh := congrArg lift (NativeMicrocode.step_denote e ep w ip outRev c)
  convert hh using 1
  · simp only [Transpose.Tape.Impl.next, Transpose.step, denote,
      NativeMicrocode.Config.denote, machine, NativeMicrocode.machine, delta,
      Equiv.symm_apply_apply, AbsoluteTape.scanned, NativeMicrocode.symbolDecode_code, ep, lift]
    split <;> rfl
  · rfl

theorem step_none_iff (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool)
    (w : List Bool) (ip : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L) :
    Transpose.step (machine e p selected) w (denote e p selected ip outRev c) = none ↔
      ¬ Active p selected c := by
  cases hp : effective p selected (fun t => (c.core.tapes t).head) c.core.pc <;>
    simp [Transpose.step, denote, machine, delta, NativeMicrocode.delta,
      AbsoluteTape.scanned, hp, Active, NativeMicrocode.Active]

theorem step_some_of_active (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool)
    (w : List Bool) (ip : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L)
    (ha : Active p selected c) :
    Transpose.step (machine e p selected) w (denote e p selected ip outRev c) =
      some (denote e p selected ip outRev (step p selected c)) := by
  cases hs : Transpose.step (machine e p selected) w (denote e p selected ip outRev c) with
  | none => exact False.elim ((step_none_iff e p selected w ip outRev c).mp hs ha)
  | some d =>
    have hd : d = denote e p selected ip outRev (step p selected c) := by
      simpa [Transpose.Tape.Impl.next, hs] using step_denote e p selected w ip outRev c
    exact congrArg some hd

theorem run_denote (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool)
    (w : List Bool) (ip : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) (n : ℕ) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L) :
    OperationalTrace.run (Transpose.Tape.Impl.next (machine e p selected) w) n
      (denote e p selected ip outRev c) = denote e p selected ip outRev (run p selected n c) := by
  induction n generalizing c with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simpa only [OperationalTrace.run, step_denote] using ih (step p selected c)

theorem trace_stepN (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool)
    (w : List Bool) (ip : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) {n : ℕ} {c d : NativeMicrocode.Config T L}
    (h : OperationalTrace.Trace (step p selected) (Active p selected) n c d) :
    Transpose.stepN (machine e p selected) w n (denote e p selected ip outRev c) =
      some (denote e p selected ip outRev d) := by
  induction h with
  | refl c => rfl
  | cons ha tr ih =>
    rw [Transpose.stepN, step_some_of_active e p selected w ip outRev _ ha]
    exact ih

theorem inactive_fixed (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L)
    (ha : ¬ Active p selected c) : step p selected c = c :=
  NativeMicrocode.inactive_fixed _ c ha

end TransposeFollowup.NativeReadFusion

is updated only by the finite microinstruction, and the whole configuration
refines the checked native compiler. -/

open FixedTapeCompiler
set_option autoImplicit false
variable {T L : Type*}

def shiftPositions (pos : T → ℤ) (d : ℤ) : T → ℤ := fun t => pos t + d

@[simp] theorem shiftPositions_zero (pos : T → ℤ) : shiftPositions pos 0 = pos := by
  funext t; simp [shiftPositions]

    shiftPositions (shiftPositions pos a) b = shiftPositions pos (a + b) := by
  funext t; simp [shiftPositions, add_assoc]

structure Config (T L : Type*) where
  core : Microcode.Config T L
  pos : T → ℤ

  core := Microcode.step p c.core
  pos := match p c.core.pc with
    | .act actions _ => fun t => (NativeMicrocode.direction (actions t).move).shift (c.pos t)
    | _ => c.pos

def Config.denote (c : Config T L) : NativeMicrocode.Config T L where
  core := c.core.denote
  pos := c.pos

    (step p c).denote = NativeMicrocode.step p c.denote := by
  exact congrArg₂ NativeMicrocode.Config.mk (Microcode.step_refines p c.core) rfl

  induction n generalizing c with
  | zero => rfl

    run p (n + m) c = run p m (run p n c) := OperationalTrace.run_add _ _ _ _

    t c.denote (NativeMicrocode.run p n c.denote) at htr
  rw [hr] at htr
  exact ⟨t, ht, htr⟩

variable {r : ℕ}

noncomputable def paths (F : Fin (r+1) → RationalMobius) (K : ℕ) (w : List Bool) :
    Fin (nativeMachine F K).k → ℕ → ℤ := fun p t =>
  (OperationalTrace.run (Transpose.Tape.Impl.next (nativeMachine F K) w) t (Transpose.init (nativeMachine F K))).workPos p

noncomputable def pagePorts (F : Fin (r+1) → RationalMobius) (K : ℕ) :

    intro p q h
    exact Option.some.inj (Sum.inr.inj (Sum.inl.inj ((nativeEncoding F K).port.injective h)))

    (by unfold GeneratorRows.stride;omega) (GeneratedRowClock.rows F n) hne p

/-! Every fixed finite port/label system admits the original Fin encodings,
with any chosen start label mapped to native state zero. Choosing this
finite enumeration is part of fixing the machine, not a runtime operation. -/

namespace TransposeFollowup.NativeMicrocode

open FixedTapeCompiler
set_option autoImplicit false
variable {T L : Type*} [Fintype T] [Fintype L]

noncomputable def initialEncoding (start : L) :
    Encoding T L (Fintype.card T) (Fintype.card L - 1) := by
  classical
  letI : Nonempty L := ⟨start⟩
  have h : Fintype.card L = Fintype.card L - 1 + 1 := by
    have := Fintype.card_pos (α := L)
    omega
  let e : L ≃ Fin (Fintype.card L - 1 + 1) := Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq h
  exact ⟨Fintype.equivFin T, e.trans (Equiv.swap (e start) 0)⟩

@[simp] theorem initialEncoding_start (start : L) :
    (initialEncoding (T := T) start).label start = 0 := by
  classical
  simp [initialEncoding]


end TransposeFollowup.NativeMicrocode

import TransposeFollowup.NativeMicrocodeRunCore

/-! Add physical access to the original read-only input and write-only
output. Existing work-tape microcode remains reusable without changing its
instructions or paying an unbounded oracle. Every new instruction is one
original TM transition. -/
namespace TransposeFollowup.NativeIO
open FixedTapeCompiler
open NativeMicrocode (Encoding symbolCode symbolDecode)
set_option autoImplicit false
variable {T L : Type*} {k q : ℕ}

inductive Instruction (T L : Type*)
  | work (i : Microcode.Instruction T L)
  | readInput (next : Option Bool → L)
  | moveInput (dir : Transpose.Dir) (next : L)
  | output (bit : Bool) (next : L)

abbrev Program (T L : Type*) := L → Instruction T L

def workProgram (p : Program T L) : Microcode.Program T L :=
  fun pc => match p pc with | .work i => i | _ => .reject

def delta (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L)
    (s : Fin (q+1)) (input : Option Bool) (scanned : Fin k → Fin 5) :
    Option (Fin (q+1) × Transpose.Dir × (Fin k → Fin 5 × Transpose.Dir) × Option Bool) :=
  match p (e.label.symm s) with
  | .work _ => NativeMicrocode.delta e (workProgram p) s input scanned
  | .readInput next => some (e.label (next input),.stay,fun i => (scanned i,.stay),none)
  | .moveInput dir next => some (e.label next,dir,fun i => (scanned i,.stay),none)
  | .output bit next => some (e.label next,.stay,fun i => (scanned i,.stay),some bit)

abbrev machine (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) : Transpose.TM where
  k:=k; g:=4; q:=q; δ:=delta e p

structure Config (T L : Type*) where
  work : NativeMicrocode.Config T L
  inputPos : ℤ
  outRev : List Bool

def Config.denote (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (c : Config T L) : Transpose.Config (machine e p) where
  state:=e.label c.work.core.pc
  inPos:=c.inputPos
  work:=fun i z => symbolCode (AbsoluteTape.cells (c.work.core.tapes (e.port.symm i))
    (c.work.pos (e.port.symm i)) z)
  workPos:=fun i => c.work.pos (e.port.symm i)
  outRev:=c.outRev

def setLabel (c : Config T L) (next : L) : Config T L :=
  {c with work:={c.work with core:={c.work.core with pc:=next}}}

def step (p : Program T L) (w : List Bool) (c : Config T L) : Config T L :=
  match p c.work.core.pc with
  | .work _ => {c with work:=NativeMicrocode.step (workProgram p) c.work}
  | .readInput next => setLabel c (next (Transpose.readInput w c.inputPos))
  | .moveInput dir next => {setLabel c next with inputPos:=dir.shift c.inputPos}
  | .output bit next => {setLabel c next with outRev:=bit::c.outRev}

def Active (p : Program T L) (c : Config T L) : Prop :=
  match p c.work.core.pc with | .work i => i≠.halt ∧ i≠.reject | _ => True

/-- The same one-step jump rule includes unchanged input and output state. -/
theorem jump_trace (p : Program T L) (w : List Bool) (c : Config T L) (next : L)
    (h : p c.work.core.pc = .work (.jump next)) :
    OperationalTrace.Trace (step p w) (Active p) 1 c (setLabel c next) := by
  apply OperationalTrace.Trace.cons
  · simp [Active, h]
  · have hs : step p w c = setLabel c next := by
      simp [step, workProgram, NativeMicrocode.step, Microcode.actualStep, setLabel, h]
    rw [hs]
    exact .refl _

theorem step_none_iff (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (w : List Bool) (c : Config T L) :
    Transpose.step (machine e p) w (c.denote e p)=none ↔ ¬Active p c := by
  cases hp : p c.work.core.pc with
  | work i => cases i <;> simp [Transpose.step,Config.denote,machine,delta,NativeMicrocode.delta,workProgram,hp,Active]
  | _ => simp [Transpose.step,Config.denote,machine,delta,hp,Active]

theorem step_denote_core (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (w : List Bool) (c : Config T L) :
    NativeMicrocode.totalStep (machine e p) w (c.denote e p)=(step p w c).denote e p := by
  cases hp : p c.work.core.pc with
  | work i =>
    let lift : Transpose.Config (NativeMicrocode.machine e (workProgram p)) →
        Transpose.Config (machine e p) :=
      fun d => ⟨d.state, d.inPos, d.work, d.workPos, d.outRev⟩
    have hh := congrArg lift
      (NativeMicrocode.step_denote_core e (workProgram p) w c.inputPos c.outRev c.work)
    convert hh using 1
    · simp only [NativeMicrocode.totalStep, Transpose.step, Config.denote,
        NativeMicrocode.Config.denote, machine, NativeMicrocode.machine, delta,
        Equiv.symm_apply_apply, hp, lift]
      split <;> rfl
    · simp only [step, hp, Config.denote, lift, NativeMicrocode.Config.denote]
  | _ =>
    simp only [NativeMicrocode.totalStep,Transpose.step,Config.denote,machine,delta,
      Equiv.symm_apply_apply,hp,AbsoluteTape.scanned,Option.getD_some,step,setLabel,Transpose.Dir.shift]
    congr 1
    funext i z
    split_ifs with hz
    · subst z; simp [AbsoluteTape.scanned]
    · simp [hz]

theorem step_some_of_active (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (w : List Bool)
    (c : Config T L) (ha : Active p c) :
    Transpose.step (machine e p) w (c.denote e p)=some ((step p w c).denote e p) := by
  cases hs : Transpose.step (machine e p) w (c.denote e p) with
  | none => exact False.elim ((step_none_iff e p w c).mp hs ha)
  | some d =>
    have hd : d=(step p w c).denote e p := by
      simpa [NativeMicrocode.totalStep,hs] using step_denote_core e p w c
    exact congrArg some hd

theorem trace_stepN (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (w : List Bool)
    {n : ℕ} {c d : Config T L} (h : OperationalTrace.Trace (step p w) (Active p) n c d) :
    Transpose.stepN (machine e p) w n (c.denote e p)=some (d.denote e p) := by
  induction h with
  | refl c => rfl
  | cons ha tr ih => rw [Transpose.stepN,step_some_of_active e p w _ ha]; exact ih

theorem work_step (p : Program T L) (w : List Bool) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L)
    (ha : NativeMicrocode.Active (workProgram p) c) (inputPos : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) :
    step p w ⟨c,inputPos,outRev⟩=⟨NativeMicrocode.step (workProgram p) c,inputPos,outRev⟩ ∧
      Active p ⟨c,inputPos,outRev⟩ := by
  cases hp : p c.core.pc with
  | work i => exact ⟨by simp [step,hp],by simpa only [Active,hp,NativeMicrocode.Active,workProgram] using ha⟩
  | _ => simp [NativeMicrocode.Active,workProgram,hp] at ha

theorem lift_work_trace (p : Program T L) (w : List Bool) (inputPos : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool)
    {n : ℕ} {c d : NativeMicrocode.Config T L}
    (h : OperationalTrace.Trace (NativeMicrocode.step (workProgram p)) (NativeMicrocode.Active (workProgram p)) n c d) :
    OperationalTrace.Trace (step p w) (Active p) n ⟨c,inputPos,outRev⟩ ⟨d,inputPos,outRev⟩ := by
  induction h with
  | refl c => exact .refl _
  | cons ha tr ih =>
    apply OperationalTrace.Trace.cons (work_step p w _ ha inputPos outRev).2
    rw [(work_step p w _ ha inputPos outRev).1]
    exact ih

theorem blank_denote (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (start : L) (hs : e.label start=0) :
    (⟨NativeMicrocode.blankConfig start,0,[]⟩ : Config T L).denote e p=Transpose.init (machine e p) := by
  unfold Config.denote NativeMicrocode.blankConfig Transpose.init
  rw [hs]
  congr 1
  funext i z
  rw [AbsoluteTape.blank_cells]
  rfl

end TransposeFollowup.NativeIO

import TransposeFollowup.NativeIOCore
import TransposeFollowup.NativeReadFusionCore

/-! Selective fusion for work instructions in the existing input/output
language. Input reads, input moves, and output writes retain their original
one-transition behavior. A read never fuses an IO instruction. -/
namespace TransposeFollowup.NativeIOFusion
open FixedTapeCompiler
open NativeMicrocode (Encoding symbolCode symbolDecode)
open NativeIO (Program Config workProgram)
set_option autoImplicit false
variable {T L : Type*} {k q : ℕ}

def delta (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (selected : L → Bool)
    (s : Fin (q+1)) (input : Option Bool) (scanned : Fin k → Fin 5) :
    Option (Fin (q+1) × Transpose.Dir × (Fin k → Fin 5 × Transpose.Dir) × Option Bool) :=
  match p (e.label.symm s) with
  | .work _ => NativeReadFusion.delta e (workProgram p) selected s input scanned
  | _ => NativeIO.delta e p s input scanned

abbrev machine (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) : Transpose.TM where
  k:=k;g:=4;q:=q;δ:=delta e p selected

def denote (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (selected : L → Bool)
    (c : Config T L) : Transpose.Config (machine e p selected) where
  state:=e.label c.work.core.pc
  inPos:=c.inputPos
  work:=fun i z => symbolCode (AbsoluteTape.cells (c.work.core.tapes (e.port.symm i)) (c.work.pos (e.port.symm i)) z)
  workPos:=fun i => c.work.pos (e.port.symm i)
  outRev:=c.outRev

def step (p : Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (w : List Bool) (c : Config T L) : Config T L :=
  match p c.work.core.pc with
  | .work _ => {c with work:=NativeReadFusion.step (workProgram p) selected c.work}
  | _ => NativeIO.step p w c

def Active (p : Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (c : Config T L) : Prop :=
  match p c.work.core.pc with
  | .work _ => NativeReadFusion.Active (workProgram p) selected c.work
  | _ => True

abbrev run (p : Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (w : List Bool) := OperationalTrace.run (step p selected w)

theorem active_iff (p : Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (c : Config T L) :
    Active p selected c ↔ NativeIO.Active p c := by
  cases hp : p c.work.core.pc with
  | work i => simp only [Active,NativeIO.Active,hp,NativeReadFusion.active_iff,NativeMicrocode.Active,workProgram]
  | _ => simp [Active,NativeIO.Active,hp]

theorem step_unselected (p : Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (w : List Bool) (c : Config T L)
    (hs : selected c.work.core.pc=false) : step p selected w c=NativeIO.step p w c := by
  cases hp : p c.work.core.pc with
  | work i => simp only [step,NativeIO.step,hp,NativeReadFusion.step_unselected _ _ _ hs]
  | _ => simp only [step,hp]

theorem step_denote_core (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (selected : L → Bool)
    (w : List Bool) (c : Config T L) :
    NativeMicrocode.totalStep (machine e p selected) w (denote e p selected c)=
      denote e p selected (step p selected w c) := by
  cases hp : p c.work.core.pc with
  | work i =>
    let lift : Transpose.Config (NativeReadFusion.machine e (workProgram p) selected) →
        Transpose.Config (machine e p selected) :=
      fun d => ⟨d.state, d.inPos, d.work, d.workPos, d.outRev⟩
    have hh := congrArg lift
      (NativeReadFusion.step_denote_core e (workProgram p) selected w c.inputPos c.outRev c.work)
    convert hh using 1
    · simp only [NativeMicrocode.totalStep, Transpose.step, denote,
        NativeReadFusion.denote, machine, NativeReadFusion.machine, delta,
        Equiv.symm_apply_apply, hp, lift]
      split <;> rfl
    · simp only [step, hp, denote, lift, NativeReadFusion.denote]
  | _ =>
    let lift : Transpose.Config (NativeIO.machine e p) →
        Transpose.Config (machine e p selected) :=
      fun d => ⟨d.state, d.inPos, d.work, d.workPos, d.outRev⟩
    have hh := congrArg lift (NativeIO.step_denote_core e p w c)
    convert hh using 1
    · simp only [NativeMicrocode.totalStep, Transpose.step, denote,
        NativeIO.Config.denote, machine, NativeIO.machine, delta,
        Equiv.symm_apply_apply, hp, lift]
      split <;> rfl
    · simp only [step, hp, denote, lift, NativeIO.Config.denote]

theorem step_none_iff (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (selected : L → Bool)
    (w : List Bool) (c : Config T L) :
    Transpose.step (machine e p selected) w (denote e p selected c)=none ↔ ¬Active p selected c := by
  cases hp : p c.work.core.pc with
  | work i =>
    cases he : NativeReadFusion.effective (workProgram p) selected (fun t => (c.work.core.tapes t).head) c.work.core.pc <;>
      simp [Transpose.step,denote,machine,delta,NativeReadFusion.delta,NativeMicrocode.delta,
        AbsoluteTape.scanned,hp,he,Active,NativeReadFusion.Active,NativeMicrocode.Active]
  | _ => simp [Transpose.step,denote,machine,delta,NativeIO.delta,hp,Active]

end TransposeFollowup.NativeIOFusion

import TransposeFollowup.NativeIOFusionCore

namespace TransposeFollowup.NativeIOFusion
open FixedTapeCompiler
open NativeIO (Program Config workProgram)
open NativeMicrocode (Encoding)
set_option autoImplicit false
variable {T L : Type*} {k q : ℕ}

theorem step_some_of_active (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (selected : L → Bool)
    (w : List Bool) (c : Config T L) (ha : Active p selected c) :
    Transpose.step (machine e p selected) w (denote e p selected c)=some (denote e p selected (step p selected w c)) := by
  cases hs : Transpose.step (machine e p selected) w (denote e p selected c) with
  | none => exact False.elim ((step_none_iff e p selected w c).mp hs ha)
  | some d =>
    have hd : d=denote e p selected (step p selected w c) := by
      simpa [NativeMicrocode.totalStep,hs] using step_denote_core e p selected w c
    exact congrArg some hd

theorem run_denote_core (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (selected : L → Bool)
    (w : List Bool) (n : ℕ) (c : Config T L) :
    OperationalTrace.run (NativeMicrocode.totalStep (machine e p selected) w) n (denote e p selected c)=
      denote e p selected (run p selected w n c) := by
  induction n generalizing c with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simpa only [OperationalTrace.run,step_denote_core] using ih (step p selected w c)

theorem trace_stepN (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (selected : L → Bool)
    (w : List Bool) {n : ℕ} {c d : Config T L}
    (h : OperationalTrace.Trace (step p selected w) (Active p selected) n c d) :
    Transpose.stepN (machine e p selected) w n (denote e p selected c)=some (denote e p selected d) := by
  induction h with
  | refl c => rfl
  | cons ha tr ih => rw [Transpose.stepN,step_some_of_active e p selected w _ ha];exact ih

theorem work_step (p : Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (w : List Bool) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L)
    (ha : NativeReadFusion.Active (workProgram p) selected c) (inputPos : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) :
    step p selected w ⟨c,inputPos,outRev⟩=⟨NativeReadFusion.step (workProgram p) selected c,inputPos,outRev⟩ ∧
      Active p selected ⟨c,inputPos,outRev⟩ := by
  cases hp : p c.core.pc with
  | work i => exact ⟨by simp [step,hp],by simpa only [Active,hp] using ha⟩
  | _ => rw [NativeReadFusion.active_iff] at ha;simp [NativeMicrocode.Active,workProgram,hp] at ha

theorem lift_work_trace (p : Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (w : List Bool) (ip : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool)
    {n : ℕ} {c d : NativeMicrocode.Config T L}
    (h : OperationalTrace.Trace (NativeReadFusion.step (workProgram p) selected) (NativeReadFusion.Active (workProgram p) selected) n c d) :
    OperationalTrace.Trace (step p selected w) (Active p selected) n ⟨c,ip,outRev⟩ ⟨d,ip,outRev⟩ := by
  induction h with
  | refl c => exact .refl _
  | cons ha tr ih =>
    apply OperationalTrace.Trace.cons (work_step p selected w _ ha ip outRev).2
    rw [(work_step p selected w _ ha ip outRev).1]
    exact ih

theorem blank_denote (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (start : L) (hs : e.label start=0) :
    denote e p selected (⟨NativeMicrocode.blankConfig start,0,[]⟩ : Config T L)=Transpose.init (machine e p selected) := by
  unfold denote NativeMicrocode.blankConfig Transpose.init
  rw [hs]
  congr 1
  funext i z
  rw [AbsoluteTape.blank_cells]
  rfl


end TransposeFollowup.NativeIOFusion

import TransposeFollowup.AbsoluteTape
import FixedTapeCompiler.Microcode

/-! Compile a fixed finite microinstruction program to the original TM.
Each active microinstruction costs exactly one native transition. Absolute
positions are tracked separately from the relative tape representation.
The compiler does not supply an input loader or an arithmetic algorithm. -/

namespace TransposeFollowup.NativeMicrocode

open FixedTapeCompiler
open CopyMachine (Sym)
open Microcode (Move Action Instruction Program ActualConfig)

set_option autoImplicit false

/-- Totalize one step of the unchanged original machine. This is definitionally
equal to `Transpose.Tape.Impl.next`; the bridge module supplies that vocabulary. -/
def totalStep (M : Transpose.TM) (w : List Bool) (c : Transpose.Config M) : Transpose.Config M :=
  (Transpose.step M w c).getD c

def symbolCode : Sym Bool → Fin 5
  | .blank => 0
  | .start => 1
  | .stop => 2
  | .data false => 3
  | .data true => 4

def symbolDecode (x : Fin 5) : Sym Bool :=
  match x.val with
  | 0 => .blank
  | 1 => .start
  | 2 => .stop
  | 3 => .data false
  | _ => .data true

@[simp] theorem symbolDecode_code (x : Sym Bool) : symbolDecode (symbolCode x) = x := by
  cases x with
  | blank => rfl
  | start => rfl
  | stop => rfl
  | data b => cases b <;> rfl

@[simp] theorem symbolCode_decode (x : Fin 5) : symbolCode (symbolDecode x) = x := by
  fin_cases x <;> rfl

def direction : Move → Transpose.Dir
  | .stay => .stay
  | .left => .left
  | .right => .right

theorem action_cells (a : Action) (t : Turing.Tape (Sym Bool)) (p z : ℤ) :
    AbsoluteTape.cells (a.actual t) ((direction a.move).shift p) z =
      if z = p then a.write.getD t.head else AbsoluteTape.cells t p z := by
  rcases a with ⟨w, d⟩
  have h : (match d with
      | .stay => (match w with | none => t | some x => t.write x)
      | .left => (match w with | none => t | some x => t.write x).move .left
      | .right => (match w with | none => t | some x => t.write x).move .right) =
      AbsoluteTape.move (direction d) (match w with | none => t | some x => t.write x) := by
    cases d <;> rfl
  change AbsoluteTape.cells _ ((direction d).shift p) z = _
  rw [show (Action.actual ⟨w, d⟩ t) = _ from h, AbsoluteTape.move_cells]
  cases w with
  | none =>
    by_cases hz : z = p
    · subst z; simp [AbsoluteTape.scanned]
    · simp [hz]
  | some x => exact AbsoluteTape.write_cells x t p z

variable {T L : Type*} {k q : ℕ}

/-- These are fixed finite enumerations, independent of the input size. -/
structure Encoding (T L : Type*) (k q : ℕ) where
  port : T ≃ Fin k
  label : L ≃ Fin (q + 1)

def delta (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L)
    (s : Fin (q + 1)) (_ : Option Bool) (scanned : Fin k → Fin 5) :
    Option (Fin (q + 1) × Transpose.Dir ×
      (Fin k → Fin 5 × Transpose.Dir) × Option Bool) :=
  match p (e.label.symm s) with
  | .read t next => some
      (e.label (next (symbolDecode (scanned (e.port t)))), .stay,
        fun i => (scanned i, .stay), none)
  | .act actions next => some
      (e.label next, .stay,
        fun i => ((actions (e.port.symm i)).write.map symbolCode |>.getD (scanned i),
          direction (actions (e.port.symm i)).move), none)
  | .jump next => some (e.label next, .stay, fun i => (scanned i, .stay), none)
  | .halt | .reject => none

abbrev machine (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) : Transpose.TM where
  k := k
  g := 4
  q := q
  δ := delta e p

structure Config (T L : Type*) where
  core : ActualConfig T L
  pos : T → ℤ

def step (p : Program T L) (c : Config T L) : Config T L where
  core := Microcode.actualStep p c.core
  pos := match p c.core.pc with
    | .act actions _ => fun t => (direction (actions t).move).shift (c.pos t)
    | _ => c.pos

def Config.denote (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (inputPos : ℤ)
    (outRev : List Bool) (c : Config T L) : Transpose.Config (machine e p) where
  state := e.label c.core.pc
  inPos := inputPos
  work := fun i z => symbolCode (AbsoluteTape.cells (c.core.tapes (e.port.symm i))
    (c.pos (e.port.symm i)) z)
  workPos := fun i => c.pos (e.port.symm i)
  outRev := outRev

theorem step_denote_core (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (w : List Bool)
    (inputPos : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) (c : Config T L) :
    NativeMicrocode.totalStep (machine e p) w (c.denote e p inputPos outRev) =
      (step p c).denote e p inputPos outRev := by
  cases hp : p c.core.pc with
  | act actions next =>
    simp only [NativeMicrocode.totalStep, Transpose.step, Config.denote, machine, delta,
      Equiv.symm_apply_apply, hp, AbsoluteTape.scanned, Option.getD_some,
      step, Microcode.actualStep]
    congr 1
    funext i z
    rw [action_cells]
    split_ifs with hz
    · cases (actions (e.port.symm i)).write <;> simp [hz]
    · simp [hz]
  | halt | reject =>
    simp [NativeMicrocode.totalStep, Transpose.step, Config.denote, machine, delta,
      hp, step, Microcode.actualStep]
  | _ =>
    simp only [NativeMicrocode.totalStep, Transpose.step, Config.denote, machine, delta,
      Equiv.symm_apply_apply, hp, AbsoluteTape.scanned, symbolDecode_code,
      Option.getD_some, step, Microcode.actualStep]
    congr 1
    funext i z
    split_ifs with hz
    · subst z; simp [AbsoluteTape.scanned]
    · simp [hz]

end TransposeFollowup.NativeMicrocode

import TransposeFollowup.NativeMicrocodeCore

/-! Exact finite-program execution in the first paper's machine model.
The run theorem preserves all absolute head positions. Active traces give
the partial stepN semantics, so a frozen halted run cannot count as further
executed instructions. Both halt and reject stop the compiled machine. -/

namespace TransposeFollowup.NativeMicrocode

open FixedTapeCompiler
open Microcode (Instruction Program)

set_option autoImplicit false
variable {T L : Type*} {k q : ℕ}

def Active (p : Program T L) (c : Config T L) : Prop :=
  p c.core.pc ≠ .halt ∧ p c.core.pc ≠ .reject

/-- A jump changes only the control label and consumes exactly one active step. -/
theorem jump_trace (p : Program T L) (c : Config T L) (next : L)
    (h : p c.core.pc = .jump next) :
    OperationalTrace.Trace (step p) (Active p) 1 c
      {c with core := {c.core with pc := next}} := by
  apply OperationalTrace.Trace.cons
  · simp [Active, h]
  · have hs : step p c = {c with core := {c.core with pc := next}} := by
      simp [step, Microcode.actualStep, h]
    rw [hs]
    exact .refl _

theorem step_none_iff (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (w : List Bool)
    (inputPos : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) (c : Config T L) :
    Transpose.step (machine e p) w (c.denote e p inputPos outRev) = none ↔
      ¬ Active p c := by
  cases hp : p c.core.pc <;>
    simp [Transpose.step, Config.denote, machine, delta, hp, Active]

theorem step_some_of_active (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (w : List Bool)
    (inputPos : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) (c : Config T L) (ha : Active p c) :
    Transpose.step (machine e p) w (c.denote e p inputPos outRev) =
      some ((step p c).denote e p inputPos outRev) := by
  cases hs : Transpose.step (machine e p) w (c.denote e p inputPos outRev) with
  | none => exact False.elim ((step_none_iff e p w inputPos outRev c).mp hs ha)
  | some d =>
    have hd : d = (step p c).denote e p inputPos outRev := by
      simpa [NativeMicrocode.totalStep, hs] using step_denote_core e p w inputPos outRev c
    exact congrArg some hd

abbrev run (p : Program T L) := OperationalTrace.run (step p)

theorem run_core (p : Program T L) (n : ℕ) (c : Config T L) :
    (run p n c).core = Microcode.actualRun p n c.core := by
  induction n generalizing c with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simpa only [run, OperationalTrace.run, step] using ih (step p c)

theorem run_denote_core (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (w : List Bool)
    (inputPos : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) (n : ℕ) (c : Config T L) :
    OperationalTrace.run (NativeMicrocode.totalStep (machine e p) w) n
      (c.denote e p inputPos outRev) = (run p n c).denote e p inputPos outRev := by
  induction n generalizing c with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simpa only [OperationalTrace.run, step_denote_core] using ih (step p c)

/-- A previously checked relative-tape computation transfers to native
states and every cell, measured relative to the actual final head. Input
position and output are preserved. Head resets still require a position
proof; they do not follow from an equality of relative tapes. -/
theorem actual_result_transfers_core (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L)
    (w : List Bool) (inputPos : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) (n : ℕ)
    (c : Config T L) (d : Microcode.ActualConfig T L)
    (h : Microcode.actualRun p n c.core = d) :
    let v := OperationalTrace.run (NativeMicrocode.totalStep (machine e p) w) n
      (c.denote e p inputPos outRev)
    v.state = e.label d.pc ∧ v.inPos = inputPos ∧ v.outRev = outRev ∧
      ∀ t z, v.work (e.port t) (v.workPos (e.port t) + z) =
        symbolCode ((d.tapes t).nth z) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [run_denote_core]
  have hc : (run p n c).core = d := (run_core p n c).trans h
  refine ⟨congrArg (fun x : Microcode.ActualConfig T L => e.label x.pc) hc,
    rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  intro t z
  simp [Config.denote, AbsoluteTape.cells, hc]

theorem trace_stepN (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (w : List Bool)
    (inputPos : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) {n : ℕ} {c d : Config T L}
    (h : OperationalTrace.Trace (step p) (Active p) n c d) :
    Transpose.stepN (machine e p) w n (c.denote e p inputPos outRev) =
      some (d.denote e p inputPos outRev) := by
  induction h with
  | refl c => rfl
  | cons ha tr ih =>
    rw [Transpose.stepN, step_some_of_active e p w inputPos outRev _ ha]
    exact ih

def blankConfig (start : L) : Config T L where
  core := ⟨start, fun _ => AbsoluteTape.blank⟩
  pos := fun _ => 0

theorem blank_denote (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L) (start : L)
    (hs : e.label start = 0) :
    (blankConfig start).denote e p 0 [] = Transpose.init (machine e p) := by
  unfold Config.denote blankConfig Transpose.init
  rw [hs]
  congr 1
  funext i z
  rw [AbsoluteTape.blank_cells]
  rfl

theorem operationalRun_eq_iterate {C : Type*} (f : C → C) (n : ℕ) (c : C) :
    OperationalTrace.run f n c = f^[n] c := by
  induction n generalizing c with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [OperationalTrace.run, ih, Function.iterate_succ_apply]



theorem inactive_fixed (p : Program T L) (c : Config T L) (ha : ¬ Active p c) :
    step p c = c := by
  cases hp : p c.core.pc <;> simp_all [Active, step, Microcode.actualStep]

/-- Stopping at or before n microsteps yields the original bounded-halting
predicate. This program class itself leaves input and output untouched. -/
theorem computesWithin_of_stopped (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Program T L)
    (w : List Bool) (start : L) (hs : e.label start = 0) (n : ℕ)
    (hh : ¬ Active p (run p n (blankConfig start))) :
    Transpose.ComputesWithin (machine e p) w [] n := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htr⟩ := OperationalTrace.prune (step p) (Active p)
    (inactive_fixed p) n (blankConfig start)
  refine ⟨t, ht, (run p n (blankConfig start)).denote e p 0 [], ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
  · rw [← blank_denote e p start hs]
    exact trace_stepN e p w 0 [] htr
  · exact (step_none_iff e p w 0 [] _).mpr hh

end TransposeFollowup.NativeMicrocode

import TransposeFollowup.NativeMicrocodeRunCore

/-! Fuse a selected local work-tape read with its chosen action or jump.
The selected label set is fixed. The decision uses only the currently
scanned symbol. Every effective instruction is one original TM transition;
all unselected labels retain their previous transition semantics. -/
namespace TransposeFollowup.NativeReadFusion
open FixedTapeCompiler
open NativeMicrocode (Encoding symbolCode symbolDecode)
set_option autoImplicit false
variable {T L : Type*} {k q : ℕ}

def instruction (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (heads : T → CopyMachine.Sym Bool)
    (pc : L) : Microcode.Instruction T L :=
  if selected pc then match p pc with
    | .read t next => match p (next (heads t)) with
      | .act acts dest => .act acts dest
      | .jump dest => .jump dest
      | _ => .jump (next (heads t))
    | i => i
  else p pc

def effective (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (heads : T → CopyMachine.Sym Bool) :
    Microcode.Program T L := instruction p selected heads

def step (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L) : NativeMicrocode.Config T L :=
  NativeMicrocode.step (effective p selected (fun t => (c.core.tapes t).head)) c

def Active (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L) : Prop :=
  NativeMicrocode.Active (effective p selected (fun t => (c.core.tapes t).head)) c

abbrev run (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) := OperationalTrace.run (step p selected)

def delta (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool)
    (s : Fin (q+1)) (input : Option Bool) (scanned : Fin k → Fin 5) :
    Option (Fin (q+1) × Transpose.Dir × (Fin k → Fin 5 × Transpose.Dir) × Option Bool) :=
  NativeMicrocode.delta e (effective p selected (fun t => symbolDecode (scanned (e.port t)))) s input scanned

abbrev machine (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) : Transpose.TM where
  k:=k;g:=4;q:=q;δ:=delta e p selected

def denote (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool)
    (ip : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L) : Transpose.Config (machine e p selected) where
  state:=e.label c.core.pc
  inPos:=ip
  work:=fun i z => symbolCode (AbsoluteTape.cells (c.core.tapes (e.port.symm i)) (c.pos (e.port.symm i)) z)
  workPos:=fun i => c.pos (e.port.symm i)
  outRev:=outRev

theorem instruction_unselected (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (heads : T → CopyMachine.Sym Bool)
    (pc : L) (h:selected pc=false) : instruction p selected heads pc=p pc := by simp [instruction,h]

theorem step_unselected (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L)
    (h:selected c.core.pc=false) : step p selected c=NativeMicrocode.step p c := by
  simp [step,NativeMicrocode.step,Microcode.actualStep,effective,instruction,h]

theorem active_iff (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L) :
    Active p selected c ↔ NativeMicrocode.Active p c := by
  unfold Active NativeMicrocode.Active effective instruction
  by_cases hs : selected c.core.pc = true
  · simp only [hs, ite_true]
    cases hp : p c.core.pc with
    | read t next => cases h : p (next ((c.core.tapes t).head)) <;> simp [h]
    | _ => simp
  · simp [hs]


theorem step_read_act (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L)
    (t : T) (next : CopyMachine.Sym Bool → L) (acts : T → Microcode.Action) (dest : L)
    (hs:selected c.core.pc=true) (hp:p c.core.pc=.read t next) (hn:p (next ((c.core.tapes t).head))=.act acts dest) :
    step p selected c=NativeMicrocode.step p (NativeMicrocode.step p c) := by
  simp [step,NativeMicrocode.step,Microcode.actualStep,effective,instruction,hs,hp,hn]

theorem step_read_jump (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L)
    (t : T) (next : CopyMachine.Sym Bool → L) (dest : L)
    (hs:selected c.core.pc=true) (hp:p c.core.pc=.read t next) (hn:p (next ((c.core.tapes t).head))=.jump dest) :
    step p selected c=NativeMicrocode.step p (NativeMicrocode.step p c) := by
  simp [step,NativeMicrocode.step,Microcode.actualStep,effective,instruction,hs,hp,hn]

theorem step_denote_core (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool)
    (w : List Bool) (ip : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L) :
    NativeMicrocode.totalStep (machine e p selected) w (denote e p selected ip outRev c)=
      denote e p selected ip outRev (step p selected c) := by
  let ep := effective p selected (fun t => (c.core.tapes t).head)
  let lift : Transpose.Config (NativeMicrocode.machine e ep) →
      Transpose.Config (machine e p selected) :=
    fun d => ⟨d.state, d.inPos, d.work, d.workPos, d.outRev⟩
  have hh := congrArg lift (NativeMicrocode.step_denote_core e ep w ip outRev c)
  convert hh using 1
  · simp only [NativeMicrocode.totalStep, Transpose.step, denote,
      NativeMicrocode.Config.denote, machine, NativeMicrocode.machine, delta,
      Equiv.symm_apply_apply, AbsoluteTape.scanned, NativeMicrocode.symbolDecode_code, ep, lift]
    split <;> rfl
  · rfl

theorem step_none_iff (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool)
    (w : List Bool) (ip : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L) :
    Transpose.step (machine e p selected) w (denote e p selected ip outRev c) = none ↔
      ¬ Active p selected c := by
  cases hp : effective p selected (fun t => (c.core.tapes t).head) c.core.pc <;>
    simp [Transpose.step, denote, machine, delta, NativeMicrocode.delta,
      AbsoluteTape.scanned, hp, Active, NativeMicrocode.Active]

theorem step_some_of_active (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool)
    (w : List Bool) (ip : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L)
    (ha : Active p selected c) :
    Transpose.step (machine e p selected) w (denote e p selected ip outRev c) =
      some (denote e p selected ip outRev (step p selected c)) := by
  cases hs : Transpose.step (machine e p selected) w (denote e p selected ip outRev c) with
  | none => exact False.elim ((step_none_iff e p selected w ip outRev c).mp hs ha)
  | some d =>
    have hd : d = denote e p selected ip outRev (step p selected c) := by
      simpa [NativeMicrocode.totalStep, hs] using step_denote_core e p selected w ip outRev c
    exact congrArg some hd

theorem run_denote_core (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool)
    (w : List Bool) (ip : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) (n : ℕ) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L) :
    OperationalTrace.run (NativeMicrocode.totalStep (machine e p selected) w) n
      (denote e p selected ip outRev c) = denote e p selected ip outRev (run p selected n c) := by
  induction n generalizing c with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simpa only [OperationalTrace.run, step_denote_core] using ih (step p selected c)

theorem trace_stepN (e : Encoding T L k q) (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool)
    (w : List Bool) (ip : ℤ) (outRev : List Bool) {n : ℕ} {c d : NativeMicrocode.Config T L}
    (h : OperationalTrace.Trace (step p selected) (Active p selected) n c d) :
    Transpose.stepN (machine e p selected) w n (denote e p selected ip outRev c) =
      some (denote e p selected ip outRev d) := by
  induction h with
  | refl c => rfl
  | cons ha tr ih =>
    rw [Transpose.stepN, step_some_of_active e p selected w ip outRev _ ha]
    exact ih

theorem inactive_fixed (p : Microcode.Program T L) (selected : L → Bool) (c : NativeMicrocode.Config T L)
    (ha : ¬ Active p selected c) : step p selected c = c :=
  NativeMicrocode.inactive_fixed _ c ha
